headline: Council to review new appointments, donations, grant acceptances, utility pole and underground facility petitions, and scheduled public hearings on zoning and public ways.
summary: The meeting covers consent agenda items including new appointments, donations, and grant requests, several National Grid and CommLink petitions for utility installations, committee reports, scheduled public hearings on zoning changes and road matters, and council votes on an election warrant and a funding source amendment.
